faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. SplitEasy is free, with no limit on the number of groups or expenses.
faq.q2: Do my friends need to create an account?
faq.a2: No. You can add a participant without an account (like "Grandma"); only the person who wants to check their expenses online needs to sign up.
faq.a3: Your data is protected by secure authentication and is only accessible to members of the relevant group.
faq.q4: Does it work with several currencies?
faq.a4: Each group has a single currency, chosen when it's created, among EUR, USD, TND, GBP, MAD and CHF.
faq.q5: Does SplitEasy make the transfers for me?
faq.a5: No. SplitEasy works out who owes what and shows you the transfers to make; you make them yourself, then mark them as settled in the app.
